body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Logitech showcased 'Squeezebox Radio', its Wi-Fi music player during Showstoppers at CES 2010, which is easy to get connected, browse internet radio stations and explore online music services like 'Pandora'.
It has 2.4-inch color display and line-in cord for most iPod and other MP3 players with standard 3.5mm jack.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
